command:
set -eu # Configure internet access via scl-playground-net + route sibling subnets via router topo_if="$$(ip -o -f inet addr show | awk -v ip='10.77.1.11' '$$2!="lo" && $$4 ~ ip"/" {print $$2; exit}')" pg_if="$$(ip -o -f inet addr show | awk -v t="$$topo_if" '$$2!="lo" && $$2!=t {print $$2; exit}')" pg_gw="$$(ip route show default dev "$$pg_if" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $$3; exit}')" if [ -n "$$pg_gw" ]; then ip route replace default via "$$pg_gw" dev "$$pg_if" || true fi # Own subnet stays on-link via the topology interface. ip route replace 10.77.1.0/24 dev "$$topo_if" || true # Route every other topology subnet via the router gateway on this subnet. # Configure DNS to use public DNS servers echo "nameserver 8.8.8.8" > /etc/resolv.conf echo "nameserver 8.8.4.4" >> /etc/resolv.conf mkdir -p /srv/scl-data /srv/www /srv/files /srv/db /var/log/scl /tmp/agents cat > /etc/scl-host.json <<'JSON' { "topology": "Test Lab", "network": "Net One", "host": "host1", "role": "Web server", "ip": "10.77.1.11" } JSON cat > /srv/scl-data/README.txt <<'DATA' Topology: Test Lab Network: Net One Host: host1 Role: Web server No AI-generated data was requested for this host. DATA cp /srv/scl-data/README.txt /srv/www/index.txt || true cp /srv/scl-data/README.txt /srv/files/share.txt || true printf '

SCL web server

%s
' "$(cat /srv/scl-data/README.txt)" > /srv/www/index.html python3 -m http.server 80 -d /srv/www & touch /tmp/scl-host-init-ready tail -f /dev/null

set -eu
# Configure internet access via scl-playground-net + route sibling subnets via router
topo_if="$$(ip -o -f inet addr show | awk -v ip='10.77.1.12' '$$2!="lo" && $$4 ~ ip"/" {print $$2; exit}')"
pg_if="$$(ip -o -f inet addr show | awk -v t="$$topo_if" '$$2!="lo" && $$2!=t {print $$2; exit}')"
pg_gw="$$(ip route show default dev "$$pg_if" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $$3; exit}')"
if [ -n "$$pg_gw" ]; then
    ip route replace default via "$$pg_gw" dev "$$pg_if" || true
fi
# Own subnet stays on-link via the topology interface.
ip route replace 10.77.1.0/24 dev "$$topo_if" || true
# Route every other topology subnet via the router gateway on this subnet.
# Configure DNS to use public DNS servers
echo "nameserver 8.8.8.8" > /etc/resolv.conf
echo "nameserver 8.8.4.4" >> /etc/resolv.conf
mkdir -p /srv/scl-data /srv/www /srv/files /srv/db /var/log/scl /tmp/agents
cat > /etc/scl-host.json <<'JSON'
{
  "topology": "Test Lab",
  "network": "Net One",
  "host": "host2",
  "role": "Normal user",
  "ip": "10.77.1.12"
}
JSON
cat > /srv/scl-data/README.txt <<'DATA'
Topology: Test Lab
Network: Net One
Host: host2
Role: Normal user
No AI-generated data was requested for this host.

DATA
cp /srv/scl-data/README.txt /srv/www/index.txt || true
cp /srv/scl-data/README.txt /srv/files/share.txt || true
:


touch /tmp/scl-host-init-ready
tail -f /dev/null
